data.description: 【艾莉丝 · 府邸晚宴】格雷拉特家的长桌上烛火摇曳，换上贵族裙装的艾莉丝端坐席间，明明穿着最规矩的礼服，眼神却早就飘向了窗外——「宴会礼仪？那也要等我先去练完今天的剑再说。」
data.promptProse: Young Eris sits upright at the formal Greyrat banquet table in her elegant frilled noble dress, proud and slightly bored by the etiquette. Her headband and ahoge remain above the composed seated pose. The full-body view includes the supporting chair and dress hem beneath a tabletop lined with crystal dinnerware. Flickering candelabra light warms the ruffles and her red hair, scattering glass reflections across the cloth while chair legs remain shaded.
data.title: 艾莉丝 · 府邸晚宴
data.identityProseOverride: Eris Greyrat from Mushoku Tensei in her childhood form, with long wavy crimson hair, red eyes, thick eyebrows, a headband and a small ahoge.
